newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stabe in late trading on Wednesday but remained under pressure from weak demand and fresh shipments, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,405-10 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,400 rupiah.
They said a tender for 3,000 tonnes of crude palm oil scheduled on Thursday in the North Sumatran capital of Medan should give the market some price direction.
"There's plenty of pressure on prices as fresh shipments are expected this week and next that should keep the market fairly well supplied," one trader said.
One trader said the decline in olein prices this week had erased its margin with crude palm oil.
"Although there's no margin in refining crude palm oil into olein, factories have to continue operating," one said.
Traders said they were still waiting for the official announcement of December export taxes.
The tax on crude palm oil is expected to rise sharply to $43-$44/tonne from $28 in November, while that on olein was expected to increase to $41-$42 from $18.75 last month.
